name: Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help patients and families at a hospital. You might greet people and give directions. You might work the gift shop, help in the office, or work the information desk.
who_can_apply: Junior volunteers must be at least 16. You fill out an application and have an interview.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: The 2026 Summer Junior Volunteer Program is full. Year-round volunteer spots are still described on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application on the program page. Placement depends on an interview and on what the hospital needs.
notes: The hospital is in west St. Louis County. The page does not say how many hours a week you must give.
